items.source: Called immediately before the run method finishes, when the application context has been refreshed and all CommandLineRunners and ApplicationRunners have been called.
items.translation: 在 run 方法即将结束、应用程序上下文已刷新且所有 CommandLineRunners 和 ApplicationRunners 均已调用时立即执行。

items.source: The context has been refreshed and the application has started but CommandLineRunners and ApplicationRunners have not been called.
items.translation: 上下文已刷新且应用程序已启动，但尚未调用`CommandLineRunners`和`ApplicationRunners`。

items.source: Called once the ApplicationContext has been created and prepared, but before sources have been loaded.
items.translation: 在 ApplicationContext` 创建并准备完成后调用一次，但在加载源之前。

items.source: Called once the environment has been prepared, but before the ApplicationContext has been created.
items.translation: 在环境准备完成后但尚未创建ApplicationContext时调用一次。

items.source:
Called once the application context has been loaded but before it has been
refreshed.
items.translation: 在应用程序上下文加载完成后但在刷新之前调用一次。

items.source: Called when a failure occurs when running the application.
items.translation: 在运行应用程序时发生失败时调用。

items.source: Listener for the SpringApplication run method. SpringApplicationRunListeners are loaded through the SpringFactoriesLoader and should declare a public constructor that accepts a SpringApplication instance and a String[] of arguments. A new SpringApplicationRunListener instance will be created for each run.
items.translation: 监听 SpringApplication` 的 `run` 方法。 SpringApplicationRunListener` 通过 SpringFactoriesLoader` 加载，并应声明一个接受 SpringApplication` 实例和 `String[]` 参数数组的公共构造函数。每次运行时都会创建一个新的 SpringApplicationRunListener` 实例。

items.source:
Called immediately when the run method has first started. Can be used for very
early initialization.
items.translation: 在 run 方法首次启动时立即调用。可用于非常早期的初始化。

items.source: timeTaken - the time taken to start the application or null if unknown
items.translation: timeTaken - 启动应用程序所花费的时间，或未知时为 null

items.source: timeTaken - the time taken for the application to be ready or null if unknown
items.translation: timeTaken - 应用程序就绪所需的时间，或如果未知则为 null

items.source: context - the application context or null if a failure occurred before the context was created
items.translation: context - 应用程序上下文，或在创建上下文之前发生失败时为`null`

items.source: Phillip Webb, Dave Syer, Andy Wilkinson, Chris Bono
items.translation: Phillip Webb, Dave Syer, Andy Wilkinson, Chris Bono

items.source: Called immediately when the run method has first started.
items.translation: 在 run 方法首次启动时立即调用。
